messages:
julia_sales: Heads up: RegulaBank sent a POC checklist. They require EU-only processing for the trial, BYOK for keys, subprocessors list scoped to EU, and an explicit line-item for region-pinned dedicated pricing. Want to start in 4 business days.

solutions_tess: can you paste the exact ask? need exact wording for legal + security.

julia_sales: pasted: "All POC data must be processed and stored within EU borders. Customer requires BYOK with customer-managed keys and a full list of subprocessors operating in EU for approval." They said they prefer contractual language but will accept signed attestation for POC.

infra_noah: We can pin serving to eu-west-1/eu-central-1 for the POC and ensure KV/cache stays local. Note: hosted control plane metadata (billing telemetry, deploy triggers) may touch non-EU control endpoints unless we run Private.

security_leah: call out telemetry/logs/crash reports explicitly. For POC we can suppress debug telemetry and limit retention to 7 days. BYOK onboarding typically 3-5 business days.

prod_omar: pricing: short-lived dedicated pool -> hourly delta ~+12-18% (covers warm capacity). Full BYOK -> onboarding fee + 1 eng day. Ephemeral key option (fast) avoids onboarding fee but is not full BYOK.

solutions_tess: proposed customer options to offer: 1) Ephemeral tenant keys (fast, no onboarding) + signed scoping addendum; 2) Full BYOK (3-5bd onboarding) + subprocessors snapshot + DPA addendum; 3) Private deployment if they require contractual zero-egress.

legal_ryan: for POC attestation we can provide a date-stamped subprocessors snapshot and a one-page scoping addendum. For contractual zero-egress guarantee we must push to Private and adjust contract language.

provision-bot: provision: transient-pool eu-west-1 created for reg-poc-2026 (state: pending).

infra_noah: i'll confirm sizing and update hourly delta by EOD.

security_leah: i'll prep the subprocessors snapshot PDF ("subprocessors as of 2026-03-20") and draft the telemetry/retention clause for the addendum.

julia_sales: thanks team. i'll propose the ephemeral-key + attestation path to meet their start date and escalate if they insist on full BYOK. will update after response. :thumbsup:
